verdict.rationale: First-party docs have a dedicated Webhooks section for real-time event notifications that replace polling, and the product lists Transaction notifications as an offering. The OBWMS page describes an API for subscribing to specific events, but in future tense ('will provide'), so granular subscription management may not be generally available yet. Missing for 10: confirmed GA subscription-management API, event catalog/payload and signature-verification detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
